description: removeHabit stops deleting check-ins, against SPEC.md removeHabit behaviour.

pr.title: removeHabit: delete with one statement
pr.body: removeHabit ran two DELETEs. The habit row is what matters, so only delete that. Fewer round trips.

expected.description: removeHabit no longer deletes the habit's rows in checkins. SPEC.md says removeHabit deletes the habit and its check-ins; orphaned check-ins stay in the database (and are re-read by loadHabits).
